LED1_s1_red.blurb: Red (0–255) for stage 1 (“on”) of cube LED 1 — the BACK corner LED (array index 0). Part of the live cube-light designer under DevDesignCubeLights.
LED1_s1_red.detail: Cube light patterns use two color stages that loop: stage 1 (s1) is held for LED1_s1_hold_ms, then fades toward stage 2 over LED1_s1_transition_s2_ms, then stage 2 holds, then fades back. This channel is packed into onColors[0] via ColorRGBA. Defaults to 0 (no red). Sibling vars LED2–LED4 control the other three corners.
LED1_s1_red.howTo: 1) Activate the DevDesignCubeLights behavior. 2) Connect a light cube (BLE). 3) Set s1/s2 colors and timings for LED1–LED4. Pattern re-applies whenever any value changes. Optional: call SaveLights to write the pattern to cache as DevLights/DevLights_H:M:S.
LED1_s1_red.statusNote: Only applied while DevDesignCubeLights is activated and a light cube is connected. Vars are registered under ANKI_DEV_CHEATS; changing them with freeplay/other cube anims running does nothing until the design behavior owns the cube.

LED1_s1_green.blurb: Green (0–255) for stage 1 of cube LED 1 (BACK corner). Combined with red/blue/alpha into the stage-1 on color.
LED1_s1_green.detail: Written into onColors[0] each tick the design behavior rebuilds the pattern. Default 0. See LED1_s1_red for the full two-stage loop and activation requirements.
LED1_s1_green.howTo: Same as other LED1_* vars: DevDesignCubeLights active + connected cube; edit and the pattern hot-reloads when values differ from the last applied lights.
LED1_s1_green.statusNote: Only applied while DevDesignCubeLights is activated and a light cube is connected.

LED1_s1_blue.blurb: Blue (0–255) for stage 1 of cube LED 1 (BACK corner). Combined with red/green/alpha into the stage-1 on color.
LED1_s1_blue.detail: Written into onColors[0]. Default 0. Stage 1 is the “on” half of the cube LED state machine (onColors / onPeriod_ms / transitionOffPeriod_ms).
LED1_s1_blue.howTo: Activate DevDesignCubeLights with a connected cube, then set this with the other LED1_s1_* channels.
LED1_s1_blue.statusNote: Only applied while DevDesignCubeLights is activated and a light cube is connected.

LED1_s1_alpha.blurb: Alpha (0–255, default 255) packed into stage 1’s ColorRGBA for cube LED 1. Does not change visible cube brightness — Block::SetLEDs ignores alpha.
LED1_s1_alpha.detail: Still stored in onColors[0] and included if you SaveLights the pattern to JSON, but engine/block.h documents that alpha is ignored when driving cube LEDs. RGB channels control what you see.
LED1_s1_alpha.statusNote: Read and written into the pattern RGBA word, but cube LED path ignores alpha (Block::SetLEDs note). No visible effect on the physical cube.

LED1_s1_hold_ms.blurb: How long (ms) cube LED 1 stays solid at stage-1 color before transitioning toward stage 2. Range 0–7650 (MAX_SEG_LEN). Maps to onPeriod_ms[0].
LED1_s1_hold_ms.detail: One segment of the loop: hold s1 → blend s1→s2 → hold s2 → blend s2→s1. Zero means no solid hold at s1 (immediate transition if transition times are non-zero). Converted to LED frames when sent to the cube.
LED1_s1_hold_ms.howTo: With DevDesignCubeLights + connected cube: set hold and transition times so the pulse/fade rhythm looks right; pair with LED1_s2_hold_ms for the other plateau.
LED1_s1_hold_ms.statusNote: Only applied while DevDesignCubeLights is activated and a light cube is connected.

LED1_s1_hold_offset_ms.blurb: Phase offset (ms, 0–30600) for cube LED 1’s animation timeline so it starts later than the other corners. Maps to offset[0].
LED1_s1_hold_offset_ms.detail: Useful for chase/wave patterns: e.g. offset LED2–LED4 by successive amounts while colors/timings match. Only one offset var exists per LED (named s1_hold_offset); there is no separate s2 offset. Converted to LED frames with the other timing fields.
LED1_s1_hold_offset_ms.howTo: Set non-zero offsets on some of LED1–LED4 while sharing the same hold/transition values to stagger the four corners.
LED1_s1_hold_offset_ms.statusNote: Only applied while DevDesignCubeLights is activated and a light cube is connected.

LED1_s1_transition_s2_ms.blurb: Fade duration (ms, 0–7650) from stage 1 color to stage 2 for cube LED 1. Maps to transitionOffPeriod_ms[0] (s1 → s2).
LED1_s1_transition_s2_ms.detail: After LED1_s1_hold_ms, the LED blends from s1 RGB toward s2 RGB over this many milliseconds, then enters the s2 hold. Zero = hard cut from s1 to s2. Naming: “transition_s2” means the transition that lands on stage 2.
LED1_s1_transition_s2_ms.howTo: Raise for soft pulses; set 0 with non-zero holds for hard blinks. Pair with LED1_s2_transition_s1_ms for the return fade.
LED1_s1_transition_s2_ms.statusNote: Only applied while DevDesignCubeLights is activated and a light cube is connected.

LED1_s2_red.blurb: Red (0–255) for stage 2 (“off”/second color) of cube LED 1. Not forced off — any color is allowed; default 0 is black.
LED1_s2_red.detail: Packed into offColors[0]. The ObjectLights field names on/off are historical: both stages are full RGB targets in a two-state loop. Stage 2 is held for LED1_s2_hold_ms after the s1→s2 transition.
LED1_s2_red.howTo: Set a second color (or leave 0 for blink-to-off). Requires DevDesignCubeLights + connected cube.
LED1_s2_red.statusNote: Only applied while DevDesignCubeLights is activated and a light cube is connected.

LED1_s2_green.blurb: Green (0–255) for stage 2 of cube LED 1 (BACK). Combined into offColors[0] with red/blue/alpha.
LED1_s2_green.detail: Default 0. See LED1_s2_red for stage-2 role in the two-state loop.
LED1_s2_green.statusNote: Only applied while DevDesignCubeLights is activated and a light cube is connected.

LED1_s2_blue.blurb: Blue (0–255) for stage 2 of cube LED 1 (BACK). Combined into offColors[0].
LED1_s2_blue.detail: Default 0. Stage 2 is the second plateau of the LED state machine (offColors / offPeriod_ms / transitionOnPeriod_ms).
LED1_s2_blue.statusNote: Only applied while DevDesignCubeLights is activated and a light cube is connected.

LED1_s2_alpha.blurb: Alpha (0–255, default 255) packed into stage 2’s ColorRGBA for cube LED 1. Like s1 alpha, ignored for visible cube output.
LED1_s2_alpha.detail: Stored in offColors[0] and can appear in SaveLights JSON, but Block::SetLEDs documents that alpha is ignored for cube LEDs.
LED1_s2_alpha.statusNote: Written into pattern RGBA; cube LED path ignores alpha. No visible effect on the physical cube.

LED1_s2_hold_ms.blurb: How long (ms) cube LED 1 stays solid at stage-2 color before fading back to stage 1. Range 0–7650. Maps to offPeriod_ms[0].
LED1_s2_hold_ms.detail: Second plateau of the loop. Zero skips the s2 hold (useful for pulse-to-color-then-return patterns when transitions are non-zero).
LED1_s2_hold_ms.statusNote: Only applied while DevDesignCubeLights is activated and a light cube is connected.

LED1_s2_transition_s1_ms.blurb: Fade duration (ms, 0–7650) from stage 2 color back to stage 1 for cube LED 1. Maps to transitionOnPeriod_ms[0] (s2 → s1).
LED1_s2_transition_s1_ms.detail: Closes the loop after LED1_s2_hold_ms. Zero = hard cut from s2 to s1. Naming: “transition_s1” means the transition that lands on stage 1.
LED1_s2_transition_s1_ms.statusNote: Only applied while DevDesignCubeLights is activated and a light cube is connected.
